current_suggestion.pitch: Curt Jaimungal interviews physicists, philosophers, and AI researchers at a level of rigor that sits between Lex Fridman's breadth and a pure academic channel — he pushes on the actual structure of arguments rather than just letting guests monologue. Your current lineup covers AI capabilities and philosophy separately; Curt regularly bridges them through conversations on consciousness, decision theory, and what intelligence actually is, which is a gap your channels leave open. Long-form solo and interview format, typically 2-4 hours, with unusually precise follow-up questions.
